cohort: 3123 high-risk infants (with high-risk pregnancies and/or neonatal asphyxia) examined 72 hours after delivery.
finding: Delivery mode and neonatal asphyxia are major risk factors for retinal haemorrhage in high-risk infants.
mod_finding: Delivery mode was a major risk factor for retinal haemorrhage in high-risk infants.
